documents.name: Clinical summary
documents.text:
Clinical scenario: Progressive cervical myelopathy/radiculopathy over 8 months.
Key findings: MRI severe canal stenosis with cord compression/T2 signal change; hyperreflexia; Hoffmann sign; failed PT, gabapentin, NSAIDs, ESI.

documents.text: Gaps or risks noted: Latest consult lacks explicit ADL impairment statement and weak inpatient site-of-care justification.
